rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Large-Flowered Climber.
Exhibition name: Crème de la Crème
rows.Origin:
Bred by Douglas L. Gandy (United Kingdom, before 1995).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Gandy's Roses Ltd. in 1998 as 'Crème de la Crème'.
rows.Bloom: Cream. Moderate fragrance. Double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
